evidence.observation: Pressure at the 3.00 Torr baseline early in growth
Pressure has risen steadily, about 0.05 Torr per event, to 3.227 Torr (+0.23 Torr)
Ar flow steady at about 100 sccm, so the added gas load is not coming from the argon mass flow controller
Thermocouple steady at 749.8 °C with normal heater power; the thermal system looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so an air leak can't be confirmed or ruled out

args.missing_evidence: A discriminating test is needed to tell a seal leak from an exhaust or pump restriction: a rate-of-rise test with inlet and pump isolated, or a check of the exhaust line and pump throttle and conductance. An exhaust O2 or residual-gas reading would also settle it.
